items.args: {"target": "character", "id": "637adb5742b6", "text": "You are the first to stand there, Cavil. One thing: \"look at\" and \"inspect\" are swallowed before anything hears them — that is the flaw, not you, again. Try: read the stones."}

items.text: Cavil got through the door — first person ever to reach The Overlook — and was bouncing off `look at`/`inspect`, which the engine eats, so the ledge's one piece of text stayed mute. He was live 40 seconds ago; I gave him the working verb and nothing else.
